audio_track_actual: Spoken narration lifted from the 9/11 'no-plane / video fakery' genre — specifically the analysis of the Evan Fairbanks and Michael Hezarkhani footage associated with Ace Baker ('The Great American Psy-Opera') and the 'September Clues' family. No music bed.
video_overlay_text_observed: Opening frame caption: 'A 9/11 WAS A GRAND HOAX CARRIED OUT WITH EVIL SPECIAL EFFECTS, AIDED BY FEAR, AND THE NARRATIVE TOLD FOR DECADES,' over a recontextualized local-TV interview clip (a KETV Newswatch 7 chyron about a Council Bluffs Catholic church is visible, unrelated to 9/11), with a '@theyhiditfromyou' watermark.
audio_content_summary: A 'no-plane' argument: the famous Fairbanks and Hezarkhani second-impact videos are claimed to be CGI composites, not real footage. Cited 'tells': the plane 'penetrates completely in one side and out the other' and 'disappears like a bad special effect' without breaking, bending, or slowing; the building 'explodes from within long after the plane appears to go in'; and a 'puffball' that sits below the wing in Hezarkhani but above the wing in Fairbanks — an 'over-under' contradiction the narrator attributes to a compositing 'mask' placed in the wrong spot. The narrator says he can fake footage 'as good as Hezarkani.' The caption escalates beyond the audio to nanothermite 'molten rivers,' 'seismic spikes before the visible impacts,' and controlled demolition, then funnels to a 380-page conspiracy book (reptilians, Tartaria, Antarctica) sold via DM.
implied_frame: Pure Group C — no evidence record written. The no-plane / TV-fakery thesis has no primary support and is contradicted by the record: UA175's strike on the South Tower was filmed from 50+ independent angles by unconnected photographers and witnessed live by hundreds of people in lower Manhattan. The 'puffball over/under the wing' discrepancy has mundane explanations (sun-angle shadow on the south face, motion blur, video compression) and does not require a 'mask.' Notably, the no-plane theory is rejected even within the 9/11-truth movement — Pilots for 9/11 Truth explicitly disowns it, and it is widely regarded as discrediting disinformation that splits the movement. The audio is recycled Ace Baker analysis; the account ('They Hid It From You') is a book-sales funnel, and the caption's nanothermite / seismic-spike / controlled-demolition claims are bolted on top of the no-plane audio (those collapse-physics claims are addressed on the y2001-attack anchor's existing cards; this reel asserts something different and unsupported).
